implemented: Hashes the frozen charter, schedule, sample-size plan, dependence policy, and risk/execution/integrity policies.
Requires a verified pre-observation registration receipt and pre-entry decision plus post-session outcome receipts for every scheduled session.

Requires at least 60 independently verified scheduled sessions and the power-plan sample size, positive robust lower bounds, cost/fill stress, fills, risk, integrity, and complete falsification gates.
Binds the exact session receipts, outcomes, timestamps, scenario economics, trust-root material, and evidence digests into the independently attested release bundle.
Rejects unreceipted zero and favorable synthetic metrics and rejects reuse of a release receipt after an outcome is changed.
blockers: No approved independent timestamp provider or deployment-pinned trust roots are configured; a caller-provided key map is not proof of deployment authority.
No authoritative immutable preregistration registry is connected to prevent replacement of the plan or evidence outside this function.
No real prospective market cohort, validated costs/fills, or external custody receipts exist; the signed test fixture is synthetic software evidence only.
The gate is not wired into the authoritative strategy promotion and paper-trading lifecycle.
